items.title: Beta 0.9.0 — liquid glass & 3D Cloudy
items.body: Liquid glass everywhere, a smoother liquid opening, brand-new Settings, Cloudy as a real 3D cloud that spins, flips and rolls, and chats and messengers that finally load and let you sign in.

items.title: Click Cloudy in his room
items.body: Open Cloudy's room and click him: he spins, flips, rolls and hops. On the desktop he does tricks by himself now and then.

items.title: Beta 0.8.3 — music player fits
items.body: The Music tab is compact and easier to use: a full-width seek bar, big centred controls, the music volume beside them and more room for lyrics. It always fits, even on small or scaled screens.
